prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1294; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claimant reported a low-speed collision in the parking lot with the insured vehicle while both cars were backing out of adjacent spaces. Claimant states she felt neck and lower back discomfort shortly after and sought treatment the same day. Recorded initial statement and photos of both vehicles. Claimant is not represented by counsel.

Entry 2: Reviewed the scene photos. Minor bumper contact on the claimant's rear quarter panel and a scuffed tail light lens. Lot surveillance footage was requested from property management, which indicates the claimant's vehicle was moving at walking pace at impact. Liability appears shared pending the footage.

Entry 3: Claimant provided treatment notes from urgent care reporting a back strain with muscle spasm, prescribed muscle relaxants and physical therapy referral. No fractures or imaging-confirmed injuries noted. Claimant asked about the process for a bodily injury claim and was given the general claim timeline. Advised claimant that I cannot provide legal advice regarding her rights.

Entry 4: Spoke with claimant by phone to confirm physical therapy schedule and whether she has missed work. Claimant reports she is still experiencing stiffness when lifting and driving for extended periods. Requested wage documentation and the physical therapy progress report. Reminded claimant she may consult an attorney if she wishes, and that she is free to decline.

Entry 5: Surveillance footage received and reviewed. It shows both vehicles moving slowly and the insured vehicle reversing into the claimant's path. Liability assessment updated to favor the insured at a higher share. Medical file remains open pending physical therapy progress report. Reserve review scheduled for next cycle.
